Who We Are & Our Purpose

A Space to Rediscover Your True Worth & Inner Strength

“Your circumstances may challenge you, but they need not determine your future. You don’t have to change who you are — you can begin by believing in who you can become.”

Every woman carries immense potential within her. Sometimes life challenges, societal expectations, grief, career transitions, or silent self-doubts make us lose sight of our personal power.

Founded by Subhasri S, a senior HR leader, Mind Health Counsellor, and Certified Life Coach, AURA Academy was born out of profound personal resilience. Having rebuilt her own life after personal heartbreak and life-altering turning points, Subhasri established AURA Academy to provide women with a compassionate sanctuary: a place where you will be heard without judgment, supported with empathy, and equipped with actionable tools to thrive.

GUIDE

With clarity & wisdom to navigate life's crossroads and align your authentic goals.

SUPPORT

With deep empathy, active listening, and a 100% confidential, caring presence.

TRANSFORM

Into the most confident, emotionally resilient, and empowered version of yourself.

The Framework for Growth

The 6 Pillars of AURA Academy

Our proven transformation methodology addresses the holistic emotional, mental, and personal dimensions that shape every woman's life.

01

Clarity

Understanding yourself, your core values, and your life goals.

Break free from mental fog, overwhelming dilemmas, and indecision. Gain a crystal-clear understanding of what matters most to you.

Identify your true personal and professional aspirations
Eliminate distracting noise and align daily priorities
02

Confidence

Building unshakable self-belief and unlocking inner strength.

Silence the inner critic and conquer imposter feelings. Learn to trust your intuition, voice your opinions, and step up boldly.

Overcome public hesitation and self-sabotaging thoughts
Develop assertive communication and stage presence
03

Self-Worth

Recognizing your inherent value and practicing self-respect.

Move from seeking validation from others to honoring your own journey. Establish healthy boundaries without feeling guilty.

Stop people-pleasing and embrace guilt-free self-care
Root your value in identity, not external approval
04

Emotional Well-Being

Developing emotional strength, resilience, and mindful balance.

Navigate stress, anxiety, grief, and emotional exhaustion with proven psychological strategies, mindfulness, and healthy coping mechanisms.

Heal from emotional burnout and past wounds
Cultivate calm, groundedness, and emotional agility
05

Personal Growth

Moving beyond limitations and embracing continuous transformation.

Growth has no age limit. Step out of comfortable routines, acquire powerful life skills, and reinvent yourself with curiosity and courage.

Adopt the mantra: Learn, Apply, Test and Teach
Turn life challenges into powerful catalysts for reinvention
06

Relationship

Building healthy, meaningful, and deeply fulfilling connections.

Cultivate enriching family, marital, social, and workplace relationships through empathetic listening, constructive dialogue, and mutual respect.

Resolve chronic conflicts and detach from toxic patterns
Foster genuine intimacy, trust, and mutual empowerment

Head - Corporate HR Certified Life Coach Mind Health Counsellor Soft Skills Trainer Certified PoSH Trainer PG Dip Counselling Psychology

Subhasri S is a senior Human Resources leader with over 25+ years of extensive experience in corporate people management, learning and organizational development. Having personally trained and mentored more than 1,000+ employees across multifaceted corporate environments, she brings an unmatched depth of wisdom to individual and group transformation.

A Journey of Unstoppable Resilience:
Subhasri’s life journey is a living testament to courage and perseverance. Having navigated formidable personal challenges from an early age, she learned that fortitude is forged in adversity. The unexpected loss of her husband in 2019 became a profound turning point. Rather than yielding to despair, she chose to rebuild her life, pursue advanced post-graduate qualifications in Counselling Psychology, and dedicate her existence to helping other women discover their self-worth.

Her life philosophy is beautifully distilled into four actionable words:
“Learn, Apply, Test and Teach from Experience.”

Clarity First

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about starting your coaching and counselling journey with AURA Academy.

Is my session completely private and confidential?

Yes, 100%. At AURA Academy, confidentiality is our highest ethical principle. What you share in our one-on-one sessions remains strictly between you and your coach. We provide a sanctuary that is entirely free from judgment, gossip, or unsolicited opinions.

Are sessions conducted in-person or online?

We offer both! Online video sessions (via Google Meet / Zoom) and private audio calls are available for clients across India and internationally. For clients based in Chennai, in-person consultations can be scheduled by prior appointment.

What is the difference between Life Coaching and Mind Health Counselling?

Mind Health Counselling focuses on healing emotional wounds, processing grief or anxiety, and regaining emotional equilibrium. Life Coaching is forward-looking and action-oriented — helping you set ambitious goals, break through self-imposed limits, and achieve career or personal milestones. During your initial discovery call, Subhasri helps determine the blend that best suits your current needs.

How many sessions do I need to see real change?

Many clients experience profound clarity in just 1 to 2 sessions. For lasting habit transformation, boundary setting, and building unshakable self-worth, we typically recommend a 4-to-8 session roadmap spanning 4 to 8 weeks, with structured weekly check-ins and reflection exercises.

Can organizations hire AURA Academy for Corporate PoSH & Soft Skills?

Absolutely. With over 25 years of corporate HR leadership and certified PoSH credentials, Subhasri delivers tailored Internal Committee (IC) workshops, employee sensitisation modules, situational leadership training, and corporate mental wellness retreats.
